Each Dialog/Method Workflow sequence must end by first processing to the module’s Complete folder, followed by copying the Complete folder to the Workflow folder of the next Dialog/Method sequence.
Each Dialog/Method sequence must conclude by then deleting the contents of the module’s Workflow folder.
Upon completion, the page workflow progress should be automatically recalculated,updated and displayed.

Workflow milestones may be overridden in MyServer by editing Project Settings/Page Workflow milestones and selecting override. At which point the workflow progress is updated as if the milestone were completed normally.

Stage Dialog/Method must be developed.  The Stage Dialog Method is the second part of the MyServer→MyPixler handshake.  My Server places the source pdf files into the MyPixler Workflow folders. The Stage_pdf method then copies the Workflow folder contents to the Complete folder as well as the Workflow folder of the next sequence. Finally, the Workflow folder contents are removed.
